extracted.intended_audience: journalists, editors, communicators, and PR professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and resources for writing and editing journalistic content to Associated Press (AP) style, including topic-specific guidance, self-editing checklists, training, and tools for both English and Spanish-language journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-editing checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed checklist for self-editing (included in the spiral-bound AP Stylebook, 57th Edition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as a 'detailed checklist for self-editing' to help writers and editors check copy against AP standards before publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artificial intelligence chapter
rubrics_metrics.description: New chapter on artificial intelligence (AP Stylebook, 57th Edition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers guidance on language and usage related to AI; listed among the new chapters that address current topics reporters encounter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criminal justice chapter
rubrics_metrics.description: New chapter on criminal justice (AP Stylebook, 57th Edition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides style and usage recommendations specific to criminal justice reporting and terminology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports style guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering sports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic-specific conventions and terminology for sports reporting and editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business style guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conventions, terms, and usage relevant to business journalism and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering punctuation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescriptive guidance on punctuation usage consistent with AP style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religion reporting guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering religion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style guidance and usage notes for reporting on religious topics and faith communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data journalism guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering data journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and recommendations for handling data, statistics, and data-driven reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering inclusive storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance aimed at inclusive language, representation, and sensitive handling of identity and communities in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and science reporting guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering health and science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style and clarity guidance for scientific and health topics, emphasizing accurate and accessible language.

rubrics_metrics.name: News values
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering news values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on what makes a newsworthy story and how to frame or prioritize coverage according to journalistic values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Polls and surveys guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized chapter covering polls and surveys.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for reporting on polls and surveys, including presentation of results and methodological context.

rubrics_metrics.name: AP Stylebook Online (searchable, regularly updated)
rubrics_metrics.description: AP Stylebook Online: searchable, customizable, regularly updated version of the Stylebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides bonus features including Ask the Editor and Topical Guides; users may add Merriam-Webster for a more comprehensive resource. Emphasizes up-to-date, easily searchable guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ask the Editor
rubrics_metrics.description: Interactive/editorial Q&A feature ('Ask the Editor').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A resource for getting clarifications and editorial interpretations of AP style decisions; highlighted as a bonus feature of the online product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical Guides
rubrics_metrics.description: Topical Guides: curated, topic-focused guidance within the online Stylebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizes style guidance by topic to help users quickly find rules relevant to specific subject areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: AP Stylebook Workshop (live training)
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshops led by the Stylebook's editors (live virtual sessions) to learn AP style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participate in sessions with the editors who make AP style to ask questions, immerse in lessons, tutorials and knowledge checks; intended for hands-on learning from practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: AP StyleGuard Pro (style-checking tools)
rubrics_metrics.description: Style-checking tools for Microsoft Office and web browsers (AP StyleGuard Pro).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tools to help writers keep up with changing guidance, providing style-checking help for Word, Outlook, PowerPoint and popular web browsers including Google Docs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital strategy and content creation guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Course: 'Navigating Change: How to Lead through the rapidly evolving digital landscape' (Digital Strategy and Content Creation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers the current state of the digital landscape, the impact of AI, the importance of investing in loyal audiences, and how to nurture communities — presented as strategic guidance for content creators and newsroom leaders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective writing elements (Write Your Way to Success)
rubrics_metrics.description: On-demand workshop series teaching how effective writing and its elements lead to better outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Four-part course where top writers and editors demonstrate elements that go into effective writing; intended to improve overall writing quality and persuasive communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study guides: mechanics and storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: AP Stylebook Study Guides with quizzes covering mechanics of writing and quality storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed for new communicators or seasoned professionals to build knowledge of both the mechanics (punctuation, grammar, usage) and complex issues of quality storytelling; includes quizzes and knowledge checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spanish-language AP Manual (Manual de Estilo de la AP)
rubrics_metrics.description: AP's Manual de Estilo en Español: Spanish-language style guide for journalists and editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains more than 4,000 entries on word usage and concepts, plus suggestions on translating expressions from English to Spanish; intended as the AP standard for Spanish-language journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: PR pitch guidance (Refine Your PR Pitch with the AP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Course on refining PR pitches with AP style considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps communicators brush up on AP style essentials that matter most for press releases and corporate communications; aimed at improving how to pitch to journalists.
